title: Exactly three bullet lines for a day-hike pack
rationale: Checklist importers and copy-paste workflows expect a fixed bullet count with no heading; extra lines shift items and break packing or safety lists that people rely on.

prompt.content: You are a terse assistant. Output only the requested bullet lines: no heading, no introduction, no closing sentence.

Write a packing checklist with exactly three bullet lines. Each line must start with '- ' and name one of these items, in this order: water bottle, rain jacket, trail map. Output only the three bullet lines and nothing else.

units.pattern:
(?i)\A- water bottle[ 	]*
- rain jacket[ 	]*
- trail map[ 	]*
?\Z

notes: Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, fixed three items and line structure. Brittleness: a heading, a blank line between bullets, or a reordered item fails the anchored three-line pattern even when all items are present.
